integrity: Theorems proved from standard EPPF, Chinese restaurant recurrence, and gamma-ratio asymptotics. Exact enumeration is corroboration only. Historical priority remains qualified, including incomplete full-text access to a closely related 2024 paper. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: All-parameter results require the nondegenerate two-parameter Poisson–Dirichlet law. The finite-size crossing may occur at a zero-covariance integer. Only the macroscopic limiting cutoff is explicit, not the exact integer cutoff for every sample size. Conditional-on-diversity statements and arbitrary Gibbs partition families are not covered.
title: Sharp covariance sign boundary for Pitman–Yor block-size spectra
